notes.title: Update Optimizations:
notes.content:
Update Optimizations: 

1. Optimized the response speed of the navigation system for faster reactions (specifically addressing multi-pet response issues). 

2. Improved companion creature following and teleportation distances to prevent player obstruction. 

3. Fixed an issue where pets wouldn't reset after losing their target when loading a saved game.

notes.title: Update Optimization:
notes.content:
Update Optimization: 

1. Optimized the underlying code of the AI navigation system and fixed two issues. (These issues may have caused: AI navigation disorder, AI navigation failure (standing idle), AI getting stuck against walls)

notes.title: Update Optimizations:
notes.content:
Update Optimizations: 

1. Added nutrient solution recipes to the distilled water device and dew collector. 

2. Fixed an issue where beast wave monsters would often run into water when losing their target. 

3. Fixed an issue where beast waves would not attack the player's base when too far away.

 4. Optimized the behavior of No.17 getting stuck in walls until passing through.

notes.title: Update Optimizations:
notes.content:
Update Optimizations: 

1. Added safety reset for NPCs when loading saves outside safe zones (underground). 

2. Removed NPC affection limit, allowing all NPCs to reach 100 affection.

 3. Increased NPC skill leveling speed. 

4. Fixed issue where NPC constitution couldn't progress beyond level 8. 

5. Improved NPC turning speed to prevent endless circling when unable to reach destinations. 

6. Increased beast wave intensity cap from 20 to 100 (recent optimizations for group combat allow higher settings - adjust according to your device performance). 

7. Raised gathering multiplier cap from 3 to 5 (this helps builders and casual players - 5 is the optimal multiplier after balancing considerations).

notes.title: Update & Optimizations:
notes.content:
Update & Optimizations: 

1. Improved the issue of raindrops penetrating buildings. (Balanced between performance and precision to minimize raindrops penetrating structures) 

2. Increased ceiling size to avoid gaps. 

3. Fixed an issue where after dying, returning to the main menu and loading a save then dying again would not show the death screen.

notes.title: Update & Optimizations:
notes.content:
Update & Optimizations: 

1. Fixed some NPC lookup/search issues that occurred when the number of buildings increased, such as taking too long to find a bed.

notes.title: Update & Optimizations:
notes.content:
Update & Optimizations: 

1. Fixed an issue where loading a save during a beast horde would cause the horde to respawn. 

2. Fixed an exploit that allowed item duplication by renaming items in chests.

notes.title: Update & Optimizations:
notes.content:
Update & Optimizations: 

1. Increased collision spacing between creatures to minimize overlapping. 

2. Fixed an issue where sleeping for a long time would cause items generated from rot to duplicate. 

3. Fixed an issue where quick-using items from the inventory did not reset spoilage. 

4. Fixed a temporary display bug where food slots showed full durability after clicking. 

5. Removed save overwrite on death. 

6. Expanded manual save slots from 1 to 5.

notes.title: Optimizations:
notes.content:
[code]Optimizations:
1. Optimized large-scale companion battles and beast tide combat, significantly improving performance (50%-100% improvement, varying with hardware).
2. Set the UI of deceased beast tide monsters to gray.
3. Implemented safe return for companion creatures knocked into water or stuck in rocks; they will relocate to the last guard point upon next load (or to a safe point if none exists).
4. Fixed an issue where pet formations would become disordered after saving and loading during beast tide combat; now they return to their original guard positions after loading.
5. Adjusted the AI for some creatures.
This update involves major underlying code optimizations. If you encounter any issues, feel free to leave a message.[/code]

Thank you for your support! "Island Notes" has sold over 10,000 copies! To celebrate, we have formulated an update plan, which also allows players to supervise and urge our progress. Let's see how "Island Notes" will evolve in the future!

More weapon categories, flying monsters (pets), land monsters (pets), more buildings to defend against beast waves

Mysterious map (larger and more rationally designed), riding system, more story content

If the player count exceeds 30,000 (currently nearly 50% completed), we will implement motion capture for NPCs and characters, replacing original actions and adding more actions; develop a MOD editor and open Steam Workshop.[/code]

notes.title: [Major Update] New Version Released!
notes.content:
Thank you all for your attention and support! The new version of the Demo has been updated. This update includes a significant number of changes, so if you have any questions or discover any bugs, feel free to mention them in the group or game community—I’ll address and fix them as soon as possible.  

**Important Note:**  
The new version is compatible with **official release save files**, meaning old Demo saves will no longer work. Below are the detailed updates:  

### **Update Details**  
0. Added a swimsuit outfit for companions.  
1. Added a **custom NPC body shape and face-editing system** to the Demo.  
2. Added an **armor system**, including linen-crafted armor sets.  
3. Added a **dynamic weather system**, along with deep interactions between characters and weather.  
4. Introduced a **temperature system**—core body temperature is affected by clothing thickness, ambient temperature, proximity to heat sources, being underwater, huddling, food intake, and more.  
5. Added a **Beast Tide system**—monsters will track players and attack bases (can be disabled in difficulty settings).  
6. Added **lightning gameplay**—players can use lightning rods and conduction devices to harness thunderbolts in combat. (Warning: Lightning may also strike players or structures, dealing massive damage unless redirected by a lightning rod.)  
7. Added **status effects (Buffs/Debuffs)**: Poison, Bleeding, Fire, Ice, Shock, and "Abnormal" (unique to the Island Log). Weapons may randomly gain these effects during crafting, or drop with higher mutation rates when killing affected enemies.  
8. Improved **NPC AI**—she can now craft items, assess player status, give items, assist in weapon forging, and more.  
9. NPCs can **gain or lose weight** (toggleable in difficulty settings).  
10. Added a **map system** with custom markers and waypoints.  
11. Introduced **multiple save slots**.  
12. Added **tree-falling animations** and other visual effects.  
13. Added a **"Transfer Only Existing Items"** button for containers.  
14. **Creature formations** now remain intact after combat unless obstructed.  
15. Added **"Destroy" and "Disable Attack"** buttons for creatures.  
16. Expanded **difficulty settings** for a more challenging survival experience.  
17. **Visual optimizations**.  
18. New items: Poison Arrows, Lightning Rods, Braziers, and Linen Armor Sets.  
19. Revised **NPC affinity system**—some actions now require minimum affinity levels (current cap: 80).  
20. Miscellaneous bug fixes.  

Once again, thank you for your support!

notes.title: Updates & Fixes:
notes.content:
Updates & Fixes:

Important:
1. Mutant Creatures in the new version exhibit extremely high aggression toward player structures within their line of sight. Strengthen your defenses. We've added repair indicator icons for damaged buildings to facilitate timely repairs.
2. We identified and optimized the root cause of sudden stutters and consecutive frame drops, particularly noticeable in areas with high creature density. This significantly reduces abrupt performance issues.

Fixes & Optimizations:
1. Improved creature AI and fixed previous movement bugs. Enhanced priority for companion creatures to follow fleeing players, causing them to ignore attacks while escaping.
2. Elite Specialized Bears now drop crafted incubators. Adjusted blueprint quality drop range for incubator blueprints from 1-3 to 1-4.
3. Enhanced the effect of Crafting Skill levels on blueprints in Demo. Previous level 3 skill produced quality 1.3-2.3 blueprints; now increased to 1.6-2.6.
4. Fixed a bug where placing ceilings on pillars first caused them to appear slightly elevated compared to walls.
5. Resolved movement issues with Poison Scorpion pets.
6. Fixed abnormal fuel consumption during background operation of furnaces and campfires.

notes.title: Update Fixes:
notes.content:
Update Fixes:
1. Further optimized CPU-related stuttering caused by performance spikes.
2. Improved animation freeze during spear throwing.
3. Fixed an issue where quickly retrieving a thrown spear could cause it to disappear.
3. Linked shooting stability during movement to hunting skill progression.
4. Addressed slow NPC attribute progression rates.

We sincerely apologize that recent updates have included large file sizes due to simultaneous bug fixes and extensive file optimizations. We will better distribute these modifications in subsequent updates to reduce patch sizes.

notes.title: Important Optimization Updates:
notes.content:
Important Optimization Updates:
We have optimized and upgraded the project with quality-preserving improvements:
1. Streamlined RAM usage reduced to 40% of previous versions, significantly minimizing memory-related crashes/blue screens.
2. Frame rate boosted by 20-50% (varies by hardware configuration).
3. Enhanced compatibility for low-VRAM GPUs (integrated graphics with outdated interfaces or insufficient VRAM may still encounter issues).

Other Updates/Fixes:
1. Added UI markers for thrown spears.
2. Adjusted torch placement to minimize visual obstruction.
3. Implemented companion creature growth system: 
   - Pre-update fully matured companions remain unchanged
   - Partially matured companions gain full growth after one level-up
   - Final size/power depends on accumulated points and initial size (enables super-sized/strong companions).
4. Full material refunds for demolished structures (partial refund if structure health is low).
5. Fixed hay being heavier than fresh grass in weight calculations.
6. Added frame rate cap: 
   - Default limit: 120 FPS 
   - Vertical sync enabled: 60 FPS cap

Land movement speed: 1.5x
Water movement speed: 1.66x

7.Adjusted the rotation speed of story-related ships.

notes.title: Performance Update:
notes.content:
Performance Update:
Optimized CPU peak usage and enhanced system compatibility, reducing resource consumption during multi-threaded tasks and improving support for legacy Windows versions.

notes.title: Update Optimization:
notes.content:
Update Optimization:
We've optimized CPU performance and adjusted data structures for enhanced efficiency.

Important Notice:
Recently, some players have reported issues such as unresponsive movement, malfunctioning keys, or inability to collect items, rendering the game unplayable. Our investigation indicates that these issues may be caused by Windows Defender or other antivirus software. To address this, we've made structural adjustments to our data systems. If you encounter similar problems, please add the game to your antivirus software's allowlist (whitelist) or temporarily disable your antivirus before launching the game.
